name: TKD Science and Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: TKD Science and Technology Co.,Ltd. researches, develops, produces, and sells quartz crystal frequency control components and production equipment in China and internationally. The company offers quartz crystal resonators; crystal oscillators; thermistors; DIP tuning fork; plate tuning fork; SMD encapsulation of high and low frequency crystal resonators; upstream chips; and WAFER. Its products are used in information devices, mobile terminals, network equipment, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, small electronic devices, etc. The company was formerly known as Hubei TKD Crystal Electronic Science and Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TKD Science And Technology Co., Ltd.…
